THERAPY & SNEAKERS
BUILT FOR
THE LONG GAME
Most apps track your sets. T&S learns from them — and builds a program that actually fits you.
🏋️
Lifts that adapt — weights go up when you're ready. Not before.
🏃
Cardio counts too — runs, rides, swims, walks. Log it all.
🧠
Your head matters too — mood check-ins and mindset tools built in.
📈
Watch yourself grow — PRs, volume, your personal T&S Strength Score.
THE ONE THING
YOU NEED TO KNOW
After each set, rate how hard it felt on a scale of 1–10. That's RPE. It's what drives everything.
HOW HARD WAS THAT SET?
RPE 6Easy. Could do 4+ more.
RPE 7Solid. 3 reps left.
RPE 8 ← your target2 reps left.
RPE 9Almost there. 1 rep left.
RPE 10Max effort. Nothing left.
Your RPE tells the app when to push the weight up, hold steady, or back off. You don't need to think about it — just be honest.

ONE THING BEFORE YOU START
Week 1 is calibration. Don't go hard — give the app data to find your real working weights.
🪶
START LIGHTER THAN YOU THINK
Pick weights you can handle comfortably. The app will push them up once it sees your RPE data.
💯
LOG YOUR RPE AFTER EVERY SET
RPE 8 = 2 reps left. That number tells the app when to go up, hold steady, or back off. Be honest with it.
🏆
AFTER 4 SESSIONS, YOU'RE DIALED IN
The app reviews your data and locks in your real working weights. Then real training begins.

ABOUT T&S
T&S Muscle was built by Jay Wilson. Jay is a licensed clinical social worker from NC and the founder of Therapy & Sneakers, a nonprofit working to break down barriers to mental health care for people who have historically been left out of that conversation.
The app came from something he kept seeing in practice: people who got consistent with training showed up differently. Stronger in the gym and steadier everywhere else. T&S Muscle is what he built to bring those two things together.
Therapy & Sneakers is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit.
Disrupting Barriers. Restoring Wholeness.

INSTALL T&S MUSCLE
Follow these steps to add to your home screen:
1
Make sure you're in Safari. PWA install only works in Safari on iPhone
2
Tap the Share button (the box with an arrow pointing up) at the bottom of Safari
3
Scroll down in the share sheet and tap "Add to Home Screen"
4
Tap "Add". T&S Muscle will appear on your home screen
💡 Not in Safari? Copy the URL, open Safari, paste it in the address bar, then follow the steps above.
1
Make sure you're in Chrome. The install option only appears in Chrome
2
Tap the three-dot menu ⋮ in the top right, then tap "Install app"
3
Tap "Install". T&S Muscle will appear in your app drawer like a normal app
💡 Don't see "Install app"? Chrome may not show it until you've visited the site a couple of times, or it may already be installed.
⚠️
RESTORE DEFAULTS?
This will undo all permanent exercise swaps and restore the original program. This cannot be undone.
T&S MUSCLE RPE GUIDE
Rate of Perceived Exertion — how hard a set felt. Log it after every set to fine-tune your progression.
64+ reps left 73 reps left 82 reps left 91 rep left 10Absolute max
HOW IT AFFECTS YOUR WEIGHTS
RPE 9–10 → slows weight increases  ·  RPE 6–7 → pushes weight up faster  ·  No RPE? → defaults to 8
